summary: Cameco Corporation filed a Form 6-K with exhibits disclosing the election of nine directors at its annual meeting held May 7, 2026. The filing includes a press release and a Canadian report of voting results, showing that all director nominees were elected with strong support. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or management changes. This filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer covering annual meeting outcomes.
